title: Create a photorealistic vertical 9:16 st
prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical 9:16 street-festival portrait of an adult young East Asian woman standing in the foreground during a sunny water-splashing festival. She is wet from head to toe, with damp dark brown hair loosely tied back and strands stuck to her face, soft natural makeup, a calm slight smile, and direct eye contact with the camera. She wears a soaked semi-transparent oversized white button-up shirt open over a fitted ribbed cream camisole crop top, high-waisted denim shorts, and a tiny pendant necklace; water beads glisten on her skin and clothing. She holds 1 bright pink plastic water bowl at waist level in the lower right foreground. The scene is a crowded outdoor market street with wet reflective pavement, harsh backlit afternoon sunlight, leafy green trees overhead, vendor tents and red banners in the background, and many out-of-focus festival-goers. Include exactly 4 other clearly visible plastic water containers in the background/ground: 1 blue bucket near a child on the left, 1 green bucket near the center-left, 1 pink bucket on the lower left ground, and 1 blue basin on the lower left edge. Freeze countless sparkling water droplets and soap-bubble-like splashes across the entire frame, especially in front of the subject and against the dark background, using high shutter speed, realistic lens flare, deep contrast, glossy highlights, shallow depth of field, and documentary street-photography realism. Compose from a slightly high, close wide-angle perspective, with the subject filling the right-center of the frame, background people blurred, no text except an optional small white handwritten photographer signature in the bottom-left corner reading LinhNhi.
